notes: Every number shown is a row of the comparator's metrics.tsv (contract results) or, for results written before the contract, a field of comparison_summary.json with an identical definition (legacy import). The dashboard computes no metric.
Numerator and denominator descriptions come from the metric_definitions block of the result manifests; this dictionary adds display labels and explanations only.
R = evaluated reference genes in the scope (after evaluation mode, biotype filters, transcript selection, genome-mismatch exclusion and regions); Q = evaluated predicted genes in the scope.

Status: ok; undefined (zero_denominator); not_applicable (transformation_not_applied, selection_not_canonical, requires_one_reference_transcript_per_gene); dashboard-side not_available (e.g. pre_contract_result). None of these is zero.
One-to-one metrics (TP, recall, precision, F1) come from a maximum matching in which each gene is used once. Per-gene coordinate-exact counts are a different, best-pair measure and can exceed TP.
Stop-harmonised variants are supplementary: the same predictions after --add-stop-codon. They are listed beside their original-coordinate run and never ranked as separate tools.
Every value is for one reference, scope, policy and prediction run; values are never pooled across them.

groups.label: UTR-inclusive agreement (not for ranking CDS-only predictors)

metrics.label: R_cds: reference genes with an evaluated CDS
Q_cds: predicted genes with a CDS
Reference genes on the canonical fallback
metrics.definition: Under canonical selection: genes without an Ensembl_canonical transcript, scored on their longest CDS. not_applicable for other selections.

metrics.label: Loci recovered (same-strand CDS overlap)
metrics.definition: A reference gene counts when an evaluated transcript of a same-strand gene-span partner shares at least one CDS base with it. Detection, not correctness.
limitations: Under policy A any eligible reference isoform may supply the overlap.
Loci are paired by gene-record spans.

metrics.label: Reference genes coordinate-exact (best CDS pair)
metrics.definition: Reference genes whose best CDS pair (gene-span partners) has identical CDS intervals. Per gene, before one-to-one matching: can exceed TP when exact partners are shared.
limitations: Not a one-to-one metric.
Loci are paired by gene-record spans: a transcript outside its own gene record is never compared with genes its gene is not paired with.

metrics.label: Predicted genes coordinate-exact (best CDS pair)
metrics.definition: Predicted genes whose best CDS pair has identical CDS intervals. Per gene, before one-to-one matching.
limitations: Not a one-to-one metric.
Can differ from an independent identical-CDS count when predicted transcripts lie outside their own gene record (see limitations).

metrics.label: One-to-one exact CDS pairs (TP)
metrics.definition: Pairs in the maximum bipartite matching of identical-CDS genes; rows of cds_exact_one_to_one_pairs.tsv.
limitations: Other maximum matchings with the same TP can exist inside components with several edges.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact CDS recall
metrics.definition: TP / R. TP = pairs in the maximum one-to-one matching of reference and predicted genes that share an identical CDS (same sequence, strand and every CDS interval); each gene is used at most once.
limitations: Stop-codon convention: a CDS that includes the stop codon never equals one that excludes it. Compare original-coordinate results; stop-harmonised variants are supplementary.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact CDS precision
metrics.definition: TP / Q.
limitations: Q includes predictions at loci the evaluated reference does not cover (pseudogenes, non-coding or unannotated loci).
Stop-codon convention: a CDS that includes the stop codon never equals one that excludes it. Compare original-coordinate results; stop-harmonised variants are supplementary.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact CDS F1
metrics.definition: 2 TP / (R + Q): the harmonic mean of one-to-one precision and recall, on a 0–1 scale.
limitations: Gene-level, coordinate-exact; stricter than intron-chain (gffcompare-like) F1.
One prediction run, one reference, one policy and scope: not a ranking of tools in general.

metrics.label: Identical-CDS gene pairs (edges before matching)
metrics.definition: (reference gene, predicted gene) pairs sharing at least one identical CDS, any transcript pair. TP ≤ this count.

metrics.label: Reference genes with an identical-CDS partner but outside the matching
metrics.definition: The partner was used by another gene in the maximum matching.

metrics.label: Predicted genes with an identical-CDS partner but outside the matching
CDS intron chain identical (best pair)
metrics.definition: Multi-segment reference genes whose best CDS pair has an identical CDS intron chain; ends may differ.
limitations: Best pair only: a ≥ 0.8-overlap pair with another chain outranks an identical chain at lower overlap.
Under policy A, stop-harmonised variants can shift this count slightly (pair ranking).

metrics.label: CDS intron chain identical (any pair)
metrics.definition: Multi-segment reference genes with an identical CDS intron chain between any evaluated transcript and any transcript of a same-strand partner.

metrics.label: Exon intron chain identical (best pair, UTR-inclusive)
Exon intron chain identical (any pair, UTR-inclusive)
Reference CDS introns recovered (unique)
metrics.definition: Unique (sequence, strand, start, end) CDS introns of evaluated reference transcripts also present in the prediction.
limitations: Set-based: the denominator grows with the number of evaluated isoforms (policy A ≫ B, C).

metrics.label: Predicted CDS introns supported (unique)
metrics.definition: Unique predicted CDS introns also present in the evaluated reference.
limitations: Predicted introns at loci outside the evaluated reference count as unsupported.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: No partner
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: Opposite-strand overlap only
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: Same-strand gene-span partner, no CDS overlap
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: Shares CDS, < 0.8 reciprocal overlap
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: ≥ 0.8 reciprocal CDS overlap, different chain
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: Same CDS intron chain, start/stop differs
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: CDS outcome: Coordinate-exact CDS
metrics.definition: One mutually exclusive outcome per reference gene; the seven outcomes sum to R.

metrics.label: Partial CDS recovery
metrics.definition: Reference genes sharing CDS bases whose best CDS pair is not coordinate-exact.

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact, multi-segment reference genes
metrics.definition: Coordinate-exact genes among R_multi_cds.

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact, single-segment reference genes
metrics.definition: Coordinate-exact genes among R_single_cds (genes with CDS but no multi-segment transcript).

metrics.label: Historical CDS Exact_Match (structural)
metrics.definition: Identical CDS intron chain with ≥ 0.8 reciprocal overlap; terminal coordinates may differ.
limitations: Not coordinate-exact.

metrics.label: Exon coordinates exact (UTR-inclusive)
limitations: Near zero by construction for CDS-only predictors; not for ranking them.

metrics.label: Gene-span locus detection
metrics.definition: Reference genes with a same-strand gene-span partner (even without shared exons or CDS).

metrics.label: Reference genes without CDS overlap
metrics.definition: R minus loci recovered.
limitations: A gene on a sequence without any prediction record counts here; that does not establish that the sequence was processed (see processing scope).

metrics.label: Missed reference genes
metrics.definition: No same-strand partner and no opposite-strand feature overlap.
limitations: Includes genes on sequences without prediction records; whether those sequences were processed is often unknown.

metrics.label: Predictions with a same-strand reference partner
Unmatched predictions (Novel)
metrics.definition: No same-strand reference partner and no opposite-strand feature overlap, relative to the evaluated reference.
limitations: Not demonstrated false positives: the reference may not annotate that locus (e.g. no mitochondrial reference genes).

metrics.label: Novel: on an unevaluated coding reference gene
Novel: on an evaluated gene, opposite strand
Reference genes split
metrics.definition: Reference genes with ≥ 2 predicted counterparts (≥ 10 % shared CDS).

metrics.label: Predictions merging reference genes
metrics.definition: Predicted genes with ≥ 2 reference counterparts (≥ 10 % shared CDS).

metrics.label: Reference genes with exactly one counterpart
Predicted transcripts with CDS (stop-codon audit)
metrics.definition: --add-stop-codon audit of the query; not_applicable for original-coordinate results.

metrics.label: Frame established
metrics.definition: --add-stop-codon audit of the query; not_applicable for original-coordinate results.

metrics.label: Extended by an adjacent in-frame stop
metrics.definition: --add-stop-codon audit of the query; not_applicable for original-coordinate results.

metrics.label: Unchanged
metrics.definition: --add-stop-codon audit of the query; not_applicable for original-coordinate results.

metrics.label: Skipped
metrics.definition: --add-stop-codon audit of the query; not_applicable for original-coordinate results.

metrics.label: Historical estimate: exact TP (best pair)
metrics.definition: min(unique reference genes, unique predicted genes) among per-gene coordinate-exact best-pair rows. Not a maximum matching.
limitations: Kept only for comparison with older reports; never used as one-to-one TP.

metrics.label: Historical estimate: exact recall (best pair)
metrics.definition: historical TP / R
limitations: Never shown as one-to-one recall.

metrics.label: Historical estimate: exact precision (best pair)
metrics.definition: historical TP / Q

metrics.label: Historical estimate: exact F1 (best pair)
metrics.definition: harmonic mean of the historical recall and precision
limitations: Never shown as one-to-one F1.
